0022600027.text: The Philadelphia 76ers, who are 8-1 and first in the Atlantic and the East, come into this 10th game of the season on a five-game winning streak and a 4-0 road record, while the Cleveland Cavaliers are 4-4, sixth in the East and second in the Central, two games back, after losing their last two. The 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 114-106 win in Philadelphia on 2026-10-22, and they lost 0-4 to Cleveland in the 2025-26 season series. The 76ers are without Adem Bona (back, sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), and the Cavaliers are without Jarrett Allen (knee) and Jaylon Tyson (ankle, sprain).
